title: What's new in BodyTracker
intro: We've rebuilt how BodyTracker works out your numbers. Everything you logged is still here.

items.title: Smarter maintenance calories
items.text: Your daily calorie needs are now worked out from your own weight trend and food log, and shown with a range, like 2,950 ± 180 kcal. The range gets narrower as the app learns more about you.

items.title: Log every meal
items.text: Add as many meals or snacks per day as you like, and edit or delete any of them.

items.title: Mark days complete
items.text: Tap “Day complete” once you've logged everything you ate that day. Days you didn't finish logging are no longer counted as zero calories.

items.title: Tag water-weight days
items.text: Mark days like a salty meal, travel, illness or your period, so short-term water weight isn't mistaken for real change.

items.title: Uses your body fat
items.text: If you log body fat (smart scale, DEXA scan or calipers), your calorie needs and targets take it into account.

items.title: Safer targets
items.text: Calorie targets never go below a sensible minimum, with extra care for under-18s, pregnancy or breastfeeding, and low body weight.

items.title: Backups and exports
items.text: Save a backup and restore it later, export spreadsheets, or download your data day by day.

items.title: Dates fixed
items.text: Anything you log late at night or just after midnight now goes on the right day, whatever your time zone.

expectation.title: Your maintenance number may change
expectation.text: It may be different from what you saw before. That's expected: it's now based on your own data. It becomes more accurate after 2–4 weeks of weighing in daily and marking your food days complete.

backup.title: Make a backup
backup.text: Your data is stored only on this device. Save a backup file now so you can restore it if your browser's storage is ever cleared.

profileNext.text: Next, please check your height, age and activity level. Earlier versions filled in some of these automatically.
